messages:
julia: FYI opened a docs PR to update the model-catalog migration guide and a few model-card examples — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
julia: main things I changed: clarified supported variants for aurorax/nebula3b, added explicit seq-limits table, updated embed-sharding example, and replaced the old Python SDK snippet with SDK v3 pattern
sam: nice. can you call out the exact breaking change for edge-quant variants? QA wanted a one-liner in the top note
julia: good call. added a 'Breaking behavior' callout under Compatibility. text: "edge-quant variants truncate past-keys differently; recommend aurorax-quant-compat as fallback"
morgan: saw the embed-shard example — the shard-count math looked off. should be ceil(total_tokens / shard_size) not floor. small nit
julia: fixed that, added code sample too:

```
# embed sharding example (python)
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
texts = [...]  # list of inputs
shard_size = 1024
num_shards = (sum(len(t) for t in texts) + shard_size - 1) // shard_size
# submit per-shard requests
```

julia: also added a TS snippet for SDK v3 streaming change — can someone sanity check the syntax?
ryan: I'll try it locally. also we should pin the benchmark table rows to the commit id of the runner so it doesn't drift
olga: link-fix: the old benchmark CSV link 404s. updated to point at /benchmarks/catalog/2026-03-runner-v4.csv
sam: did you update the model limits matrix for longctx variants? users were confused about "max_seq" vs "effective_seq"
morgan: I left a comment in the PR suggesting a small paragraph explaining "effective_seq = max_seq - reserved_prefix_tokens". that helped in our internal notes
julia: added that paragraph and a tiny diagram (converted to ascii for md):

```
| request | reserved_prefix | user_tokens | effective_seq |
|---------|-----------------|-------------|---------------|
| 0..N    | 64              | M           | max_seq - 64  |
```

julia: docs-bot ran linkcheck; it flagged two anchors. I fixed one and left a TODO for the other (waiting on a router doc change)
docs-bot: linkcheck report: 2 broken anchors, 1 external 404 fixed, running again on merge
ryan: LGTM from me on snippets, but please squash the tiny typo commits into one
olga: can we add a short migration checklist at the top for Dedicated customers (reserved capacity implications)? they asked for a 3-step checklist
julia: yep added a bullet list under "Migration quickstart for Dedicated". PTAL. thanks everyone :heart:
sam: approving the PR once the anchor todo is resolved; can someone add a follow-up ticket to track the router doc change?
morgan: I'll create a GH issue and link it in the PR
julia: perfect — thanks all. I'll merge after docs-bot passes and Ryan's local run is green.
